lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately three horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters visible on the lateral flank, characterized by relatively uniform spacing along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure on the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-intensity, narrow horizontal linear feature is present at the anterior base of the upper caudal lobe, suggesting a localized surface anomaly or tag attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-luminance spotting is visible on the lateral surface of the lower caudal lobe, contrasting sharply with the darker base pigmentation.
